recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic red-toned portrait of a female figure in profile, featuring a heavy slab-serif title and a right-aligned tracklist. The lighting creates a soft glow around the hair and face while keeping the features in deep shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile facing left against a right-aligned text block
Monochromatic red palette unifying the background and subject
Heavyweight slab-serif title contrasting with a lighter weight body text
Deep shadows in the subject's face creating a sense of mystery and depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face in profile, specifically the bridge of the nose and lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white title in the top right, moves down the tracklist, and then follows the subject's gaze back to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is utilized for text, while the left edge is framed by a dark vertical border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant red wash across the entire image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black/dark red for shadows and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the primary display title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, black, and white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric slab serif and clean sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky serifs on the display title
Consistent stroke weight in the secondary sans-serif text
Tight tracking for the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a white slab-serif for the name and a black sans-serif for the details.
graphicDevices: Vertical dark bar on the far left edge
Circular promotional badge in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and presence for the title.
Clean, legible sans-serif for the right-aligned list.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a profile portrait of a woman with long hair, lit with a strong red monochromatic wash. The face should be in shadow with a rim light on the hair and profile edge. Include a dark vertical frame on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white slab-serif title in the top right corner. Below it, add a list of text in a black condensed sans-serif, all right-aligned. Place a red circular graphic badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic red?
Is the main title in a white slab-serif font?
Is the subject in profile facing left?

adjustableVariables: Depth of the shadows on the face
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
Specific promotional text on the circular badge

mustAchieve: Dramatic rim lighting on the profile

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red tone is consistent across the subject and background.
Check that the white title is the most prominent element.
Verify the right-alignment of the tracklist is perfectly vertical.
Confirm the profile silhouette is sharp and recognizable.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Red Wash + Profile Rim Lighting + Right-Aligned Slab Serif Typography = Moody Modern Portrait Layout
